title: International finance
audience: a college student in a finance, accounting or business degree program, or a career changer studying the same material on their own
purpose: Explain the balance of payments and exchange-rate regimes, use interest-rate and purchasing-power parity, forecast and hedge currency risk, value foreign projects and investments, and analyze international capital flows, sovereign risk and currency crises.

weeks.2: Exchange-rate regimes and the international monetary system
weeks.4: Interest rate parity and forward rates
weeks.5: Purchasing power parity and the real exchange rate

blocks.deliverable: Analyze a country's balance of payments.
Price three forward rates and find an arbitrage.
Week 7 midterm; hedge a foreign payable three ways.
Value a foreign project in two currencies.
Explain one currency crisis and its causes.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Global expansion case: for a company entering a foreign market, analyze the currency and country risks, value the project in both currencies, design a hedging program, and write a three-page recommendation.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
